account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 15:21 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT BY THE FINAL HOURLY RUN, AFTER A SCOPE PREFLIGHT THAT MATCHED THE MANDATE IDENTIFIER EXACTLY against the connector list; every other account was discarded unread. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match - unchanged from the 09:44 open read and from all five previous hourly reads because nothing has traded. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, which discharges the exit step rather than excusing it: no target, stop or time stop is reachable because no position carries one, and NO OPTION NO-FLY WINDOW IS REACHABLE because no contract is held. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so the whole of it is deployable and no good-faith violation is reachable. THE 09:50 BOX SPECIFICATION IS RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED FOR THE SIXTH AND FINAL TIME at 34.50, all three invalidations untripped, the limit moved in neither direction - AND THE MATERIAL CHANGE IS THAT THE WINDOW CLOSED AGAIN AND THE MARKET LEFT THE LIMIT BEHIND. BOX is 34.63 bid / 34.64 ask, the limit 0.13 under the bid, resting rather than marketable, and the level has not traded in fifty-nine minutes. It dies at 15:30 ET, nine minutes after this read, and on this quote it expires unexecuted.

entryWatch.setup: BOX post-earnings DAY-2 continuation - reported 8/25 after the close, a 17.6% EPS beat, day one gapped and FADED below its own pre-print close and still finished green, and day two has taken out the day-one high on expanding volume. SPECIFIED at 09:50 at a 34.50 limit for 11 shares, CLEAN - no checklist item marked fail, RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED at 10:21, 11:21, 12:21, 13:21, 14:21 and 15:21, the limit having traded through in every one of those six hours and the specification still unexecuted at the last of them
entryWatch.trigger: CONFIRMED FOR THE SIXTH AND FINAL TIME, LIMIT UNCHANGED AT 34.50, AND THE MATERIAL CHANGE IS THAT THE WINDOW CLOSED AGAIN AND THE MARKET LEFT THE LIMIT BEHIND. BOX is 34.63 bid / 34.64 ask at 2026-08-27T19:21:48.603206235Z, last 34.635 at 19:21:43.341443345Z, +3.71% on the bid against a 33.390 settled close, on a 0.029% spread - the tightest quote of the session. The limit is 0.13 BELOW the bid, which is the second-widest it has rested under the market at any hourly check today, and the specification is RESTING rather than marketable: it fills only if a seller comes back down to it, and there are nine minutes left for that to happen. THE BID LADDER ACROSS ALL SIX HOURLY CHECKS NOW READS 34.56, 34.66, 34.49, 34.58, 34.48, 34.63. The limit rested 0.06 under the market, then 0.16 under, then one cent ABOVE the bid at the touch, then 0.08 under, then it WAS the offer at 14:21 - and now it is 0.13 under again. This hour reversed the previous hour's reversal, which is the plainest way to say that this level has oscillated around the market all session and simply did not happen to be under it when a seller arrived. THE LEVEL TRADED IN 2 OF THIS HOUR'S 59 REAL MINUTE BARS, ON 12,293 SHARES, AND BOTH WERE IN THE FIRST TWO MINUTES. The 14:21 bar - the one the last run caught in progress and honestly declined to count - completed on a 34.450 low and 11,652 shares, and the 14:22 bar printed a 34.4909 low on 641 shares. Since 14:22 ET the limit has not traded in FIFTY-NINE MINUTES. BOX bottomed at 34.450 in the first minute of the window, ground up through 34.55, ran to a 34.791 high at 15:12 and settled into 34.61-34.70, so the drift of the hour was steadily AWAY from the entry. THE HONEST COUNTERWEIGHT THIS HOUR CUTS AGAINST THE FILL RATHER THAN FOR IT, AND IT IS RECORDED THE SAME WAY THE FAVOURABLE ONE WAS RECORDED LAST HOUR. Volume came BACK: 165,131 shares across the window against 129,772 last hour, the first increase after five consecutive declines, with a 15,672-share minute at 14:59 and a 10,914-share minute at 15:20. Last hour's reopening was on the thinnest participation of the session and was flagged as thin in the same breath; this hour participation improved and the price used it to move up and away from the bid. Volume ladder across the six hours: 242,776, 196,733, 304,052, 161,785, 129,772, 165,131. One bar of the sixty, 14:38, is an interpolated zero-volume gap-fill and is excluded from every count rather than quietly inflating the denominator. ALL THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS TESTED AGAINST EVERY POST-PUBLICATION BAR AND FOR THE FOURTH CONSECUTIVE HOUR NO BUFFER MOVED IN EITHER DIRECTION. First, a print below 33.76: this hour's lowest print is 34.450, above the 34.220 low of 10:46, so the buffer holds at 0.46. Second, a completed five-minute close below 34.00: this hour's lowest completed bucket close is 34.525, far above the 34.260 of the 10:45-10:49 bucket, so the buffer holds at 0.26. Third, an unfilled run above 37.95 which KILLS rather than re-strikes: the post-publication high is still 34.960 at 09:51 against this hour's 34.791, buffer 2.99, untouched. The setup the entry described is still the setup on the tape - BOX is above the 34.50 day-one high it was struck at, not back inside the 31.93-33.79 base - so there is nothing here that kills the specification, only a market that moved away from it. Adding this hour to the running count: 92 of 328 real post-publication minute bars have traded at or below 34.50, on 784,412 shares. Non-execution is established by the BROKER rather than by an empty shelf - zero equity orders returned on a created_at floor of 2026-08-25. THE LIMIT IS MOVED IN NEITHER DIRECTION, AND WITH NINE MINUTES LEFT THAT REFUSAL IS THE WHOLE OF THIS RUN'S WORK. Raising to 34.63 to lift the offer and be filled before the fuse burns is the chase the 2026-08-18 change forbids by name; a deadline is not a thesis, and an entry taken at 34.63 is not the entry the 09:50 reasoning described. Lowering is refused on the other side as it was at 12:21 and 14:21. Exits are unchanged and were struck off the limit before publication: stop 31.74, target 41.40, time stop 2026-09-02. DIES 15:30 ET, NINE MINUTES FROM THIS READ, AND THIS IS THE LAST SCHEDULED RUN OF THE SESSION. On the quote in front of this run it will expire unexecuted, which would make it the SIXTEENTH consecutive unexecuted entry - a delivery finding for the retro, not a thesis failure, since nothing invalidated it at any of the six checks it survived. The operator was notified on this pass, with the level's distance stated rather than hidden.
entryWatch.why: Item 1 is a dated number, not a chart: BOX reported fiscal Q2 2027 on 2026-08-25 after the close, EPS 0.40 against a 0.34 estimate, a 17.6% beat, verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-27. Item 2 passes on both limbs - BOX is +4.07% and the entry is struck at +3.32%, nowhere near the +8% line, and the day-one reaction bar is behind it, which is exactly the day-2/3 continuation the rulebook prefers over the spike. The second limb of item 2, the whole-list-green wait signal, was tested rather than waved through: the tape is broadly green but it is NOT uniform, with BBY -4.69%, HQY -13.72%, HPQ -7.90%, HRL -6.54%, BBWI -5.19%, DLTR -2.65%, INTU -2.78% and BURL -1.87% all red on their own numbers, and BOX is not part of the AI complex that is doing the leading. Item 3 does not bind and is logged na rather than skipped: BOX's next report is roughly late November, verified as no upcoming dated event inside the five-session window, so there is no earnings hold for a straddle to precede. Item 4 is the strongest reading on the board - a 0.057% spread on 5.96M shares yesterday against 1.4-4.3M in the week before. Item 5 reads the right way: BOX traded 31.93 to 33.79 for the two weeks into the print and was not run up, and on day one the sellers got a 32.6637 print BELOW the pre-print close and the name still closed green. Item 6 is discharged here in writing before entry.

entryWatch.trigger: NOT RE-STRUCK, AND REFUSED TWICE OVER ON INDEPENDENT GROUNDS. SMTC is 144.20 bid / 144.49 ask at 13:41:56.037586273Z, last 144.290, +2.48% against a 140.800 close and 3.90% ABOVE the 138.50 limit that expired unexecuted at 15:30 yesterday. FIRST REFUSAL, the one this board has made most often: buying it here is re-striking a dead level higher, which is the FUTU 117.90 refusal, the BJ 97.35 refusal made twice, the BZ refusal made yesterday morning, and the refusal made against this board's own live SMTC entry at 14:21 yesterday when raising to 139.16 would have bought the high of the afternoon. Widening the time is not permission to widen the price, and that rule does not stop applying because the level got away. SECOND REFUSAL, independent of the first and decided on 2026-08-21: moves.json branch one refuses any entry in the AI or semiconductor complex on 8/27 into the MRVL print, which is tonight. Either one alone kills it. Yesterday's thesis is unchanged and is not re-argued - a 24.6% beat on a name marked down 21.6% into its own print - and the fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry remains a DELIVERY failure rather than a thesis failure, which is the finding the retro already carries.
entryWatch.why: The 8/26 entry was FORCED on items 2 and 3 and every marking stands as struck. It was re-quoted and confirmed six times, all three pre-registered invalidations were tested mechanically at every hour and not one ever tripped, and the limit was refused downward at 136.50 and 135.56 and upward at 139.16. It died marketable and the miss cost 2.35 a share against the 140.85 bell. None of that makes 144.20 an entry.

The three cleanest sympathy laggards in the chain, AMD, AMAT and MU, remain blocked by the 40% single-name ceiling before any view reaches them: one share is 47.4%, 47.6% and 93.3% of the account respectively.

THE BEST SETUP ON THE TAPE AND REFUSED BY THIS BOARD'S OWN PRE-REGISTERED BRANCH, NOT BY A CHECKLIST ITEM. 203.09 bid / 203.30 ask at 13:46:54.235014795Z, last 203.485, +0.42% against a 202.250 close, on a 0.103% spread - the tightest of roughly sixty names quoted this morning. The setup: a day-2 continuation of ANET's own 8/26 breakout, which closed 202.25 AT the session high on 7,664,556 shares against 4.2-5.7M in the four sessions before it, out of the 183.75-190.94 base it had built since 8/20; today it opened 205.155, printed a 206.10 high, based 201.39-203.73 and was rebuilding. Earnings 2026-11-03 on a live pull, so no event inside the time stop. Item 2 passes at +0.42%. THE REFUSAL: moves.json branch one, written 2026-08-21 and widened on that same date to include 8/27 precisely so this morning could not fall through the gap, refuses any entry in the AI or semiconductor complex on 8/27 into the MRVL print, which is tonight. The entire ANET thesis is that it is the NVDA datacenter read-through, so it cannot be a sympathy name for the thesis and not one for the refusal. A five-session hold opened today wears the MRVL gap and a -8% stop cannot be honoured across it. The intended entry, recorded so the refusal can be graded: 1 share at a 202.25 limit - the retest of the 8/26 breakout close - stop 186.07, target 242.70. Note the size finding: the 40% ceiling permits 2 shares only at a limit of 201.83 or below, 42 cents under the level the thesis names, so the level was kept and the size given up.

224.39 bid / 224.41 ask at 13:45:17.001971557Z, +7.03% against a 209.660 close on a 0.01% spread. The catalyst itself: fiscal Q2 2027 EPS 2.22 against a 2.09 estimate, reported last night, verified true on a live calendar pull. Refused on three grounds, any one sufficient. Item 2 - the session high of 225.03 is +7.33%, a tenth of a point off the +8% line, and this is the day-one reaction bar, which the rulebook says is not the entry. Structure - 225 is the TOP of the 8/10-8/17 congestion, whose highs run 224.14, 225.10, 227.23, 227.49 and 227.92, so the gap lands directly into overhead rather than into clear air. And branch one refuses the complex on 8/27 into tonight's MRVL print regardless. Two shares would also be 44.5% against the 40% ceiling, so the position would be one share at 22.2% in any event.

67.76 bid / 68.16 ask at 13:42:21.344152061Z, +3.63% against a 65.390 close on a 0.59% spread. A 39.5% EPS beat - 0.60 against 0.43 - and refused on the SHAPE OF THE TAPE rather than the number, which is numbers-over-narrative pointing the unusual way. It opened 71.61, printed 74.42 in the 09:32 minute and has fallen in EIGHT CONSECUTIVE MINUTES since, 74.42 to 67.70 by 09:42, giving back the entire gap on rising volume. That is a day-one gap-and-fade in progress, not the day-2 pullback the rulebook buys, and there is no shelf to strike a limit at because the name has not stopped going down. BOX is the same trade one day further along and with the fade already behind it, which is why BOX was taken and this was not.

97.11 bid / 97.15 ask at 13:48:27.047766393Z, +3.50% against a 93.830 close on a 0.04% spread. Same slot as BOX - reported 8/25 after the close, and it BEAT, 1.55 against 1.38, up 12.3%. Refused because the day-one reaction was a 7.0% DECLINE: 8/25 closed 100.92, 8/26 opened 95.20 and closed 93.83 on 7.28M shares. A beat the market sold is a guidance or a mix problem this run cannot see, and today's +3.5% is a bounce off that decline rather than a continuation of anything. BOX is the same calendar slot with the opposite day-one shape - faded and still closed green - and that difference is the entire reason one was published and the other was not.

128.42 bid / 128.91 ask at 13:48:28.085820098Z, +4.59% against a 122.780 close on a 0.38% spread. Beat 2.48 against 1.99, a 24.6% beat, reported this morning before the open. The best of today's day-one reaction bars and NOT taken, for two reasons. It is day ONE, and the rulebook says the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is. And the read-across cuts against it: every other retail name that beat this morning is being SOLD - BBY -4.69% on a 1.47 against 1.37, DLTR -2.65% on a 1.39 against 1.03, BURL -1.87% on a 2.37 against 1.98 - so DG is the exception in a group the tape is rejecting, which is a reason to want the second day rather than the first. Worth the 8/28 open's attention if it holds.
